requirement.description: Missing parameter value handling in _map_function_annotations. Many tests fail because parameters with no default values aren't being properly checked for existence, causing RuntimeErrors instead of graceful handling.
requirement.contract: Update _map_function_annotations to properly check if required parameters are provided before attempting to access them. When a required parameter is missing, it should either use a default value if provided or raise a clearer error message with the expected parameter name.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of artifact loading paths. Tests fail due to FileNotFoundError when artifact files don't exist or directory issues when outputs are written to directories instead of files.
requirement.contract: Improve artifact loading logic in _map_function_annotations to properly handle missing artifact files and directory creation issues. Fix the IsADirectoryError that occurs when trying to write outputs to directories instead of files.

requirement.description: Improper parameter value loading and validation. The get_annotated_input_param function raises generic errors instead of clear, actionable messages.
requirement.contract: Enhance get_annotated_input_param to provide more specific error messages that indicate which parameter is missing and how to fix it. Also improve parameter loading to handle edge cases better.

requirement.description: Missing handling for kebab-case to snake_case parameter name conversion in _map_function_annotations. Some tests fail due to parameter name mismatches.
requirement.contract: Fix parameter name mapping in _map_function_annotations to properly handle kebab-case to snake_case conversions and vice versa. Ensure that parameter names like 'my-param' are correctly mapped to 'my_param' when needed.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of artifact path resolution and directory creation. The _run function has issues with output paths being directories instead of files.
requirement.contract: Improve the _run function to correctly handle cases where args_path is a directory by creating output files within that directory rather than trying to write to a directory as a file.
